description: List the 195 UX/UI principles, optionally one part at a time. Returns principle summaries (slug, title, code, part name, summary), the total count and the list of part ids. Use it to browse the catalogue or to learn the part ids for search_principles.

limit.description: Maximum number of principles to return. Defaults to 20.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

part.description: Restrict to one part, by id or name (e.g., "part-1", "part-2"). Omit for every part.

name: list_principles
title: List principles
